build_masked_lm_model: build a MaskedLMModel instance using MaskedLMModel.build_model with args and task
create_masked_lm_encoder: create a MaskedLMEncoder with args and dictionary for masked language modelling
run_masked_lm_forward: run the MaskedLMEncoder forward pass with src_tokens and segment_labels to get logits
configure_bert_base_architecture: configure a BERT base architecture with 768-dim embeddings and 12 encoder layers
configure_bert_large_architecture: configure a BERT large architecture with 1024-dim embeddings and 24 encoder layers
